question: The Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare has launched a PM-KISAN AI Chatbot _______ in 2023, which will provide the farmers with a one-stop solution for their grievances related to the PM-KISAN scheme.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kisan e-Mitra**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare launched the PM-KISAN AI Chatbot named **Kisan e-Mitra** in 2023.
 
• This chatbot aims to provide farmers with a one-stop solution for their grievances related to the PM-KISAN scheme.
 
• The chatbot is designed to enhance the accessibility and efficiency of the PM
